# 01-update-avalonia-package-versions: Align Avalonia package versions

Update the central package versions in `src/Directory.Packages.props` for the Avalonia core and platform family to 12.1.4, DataGrid to 12.1.2, and Xaml.Behaviors.Avalonia to 12.0.7. Keep AvaloniaUI.DiagnosticsSupport at 2.2.3, which is already the latest stable version. Do not change the .NET 10 target or add package references that the projects do not currently use. The assessment found no source-breaking changes for the resolved core packages; platform and integration references not resolved by the assessment must be verified by restore/build.

The first solution build exposed NU1010 for the legacy `Avalonia.Diagnostics` references. Because Avalonia 12 uses the already-pinned `AvaloniaUI.DiagnosticsSupport` integration and the package guidance says the legacy package can be removed, include that migration now to keep the version update buildable. Task 02 will verify this integration rather than duplicate the change.

## Scope Inventory
- **Projects affected**: `de.openelp.regatta` (Avalonia, Fluent, Inter font, DataGrid, diagnostics support), `Desktop` (Desktop and Tmds.DBus.Protocol), `Android` (Android), `de.openelp.regatta.Tests` (xUnit/Test SDK), and the conditionally configured `IOS` project (iOS). The central file also holds unused Browser and Xaml.Behaviors version pins; update those pins but do not introduce new references.
- **Distinct concerns**: Align Avalonia versions centrally using the repository's existing NuGet Central Package Management (CPM). CPM is already enabled in `src/Directory.Packages.props`; do not convert or reorganize package management. User approved adding current stable central pins for existing unversioned Tmds and test references after NU1010 blocked restore. Also replace legacy Avalonia.Diagnostics references with the current DiagnosticsSupport integration so restore/build can proceed.
- **Assessment signals**: Assessment resolved Avalonia, Avalonia.Desktop, Avalonia.Fonts.Inter, and Avalonia.Themes.Fluent to 12.1.4, with zero API-breaking call sites. Its package resolver missed the Android/iOS/Browser/DataGrid integration packages. Project dependency inspection confirms Android 12.1.0, Desktop 12.1.0, and shared core packages at 12.1.0; iOS is conditionally referenced on macOS. Stable package lookup confirmed Avalonia core/platform packages 12.1.4, DataGrid 12.1.2, Xaml.Behaviors.Avalonia 12.0.7, Tmds.DBus.Protocol 0.95.1, xunit.runner.visualstudio 4.0.1, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.11.0, and xunit.v3 4.0.2. DiagnosticsSupport 2.2.3 is already current.
- **Skill matches**: `managing-package-references` applies; `converting-to-cpm` does not because CPM is already enabled. Use the IDE build tool after the package-file change.

The Android validation build now reaches D8 but fails because the resolved `Xamarin.AndroidX.Core` 1.19.0.1 and transitive `Xamarin.AndroidX.Core.Core.Ktx` 1.17.0.2 both contain `AnimatorKt$addListener$1`. The existing central pin for Core KTX is already 1.19.0.1, so add a direct Android PackageReference to make NuGet resolve the aligned version; investigate the accompanying Lifecycle NU1608 warnings before task completion.

**Done when**: All used Avalonia package references resolve from central package management at the planned compatible stable versions, and unrelated user edits in the working tree remain intact.
